source_note: Re-sourced for #191 from the AnyWear-Infra issue-branch head: the stage and deployment contract is ordinary Infra source now — lib/contracts.mjs plus four operation scripts — with no package, no tarball and no registry consumer. contracts.mjs, deployment-contract.mjs, json-contract.mjs and operation-stacks.mjs are exact byte copies of the producer paths recorded in producer_paths. stage-contract-parameters.mjs is E2E's own stage-input reader and the only declared rewrite: its producer imports ../lib/contracts.mjs, which this copy resolves to the vendored ./contracts.mjs. producer_files records the raw producer hash of that one rewritten copy; the loader reverses the declared rewrite, asserts the producer bytes and re-applies it forward. The Service release slice is the Runtime stack: SERVICE_RUNTIME_STACK (AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta, ap-east-1, .github/workflows/mutate.yml), runtimeStackName and runtimeStageFromStack. AnyWearEgressStack-beta and AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta are operation-owned and never part of the always-present configured three-stack Infra manifest, so the recorded tuple stays three Infra stacks. E2E owns the Lambda stable-configuration projection (scripts/lambda-configuration.mjs) because the producer copy carries only the account, region and repository constants.

retired.artifact-consumer.mjs: the v2 selection consumer is removed with the selection contract
retired.vendor/service-artifact-contract.mjs: the Service parser copy is removed; the release chain verifies its own sealed release
retired.vendor/service-release-attestation.mjs: the native release attestation parser copy is removed
